# Security policy

## Supported versions

Vimex is currently pre-1.0. Security fixes are applied to the latest published `0.1.x` release and the `main` branch.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/RussGallaway/vimex/security/advisories/new) for suspected vulnerabilities. Include the affected version, environment, reproduction steps, impact, and any proposed mitigation.

Do not open a public issue for an undisclosed vulnerability. You should receive an initial response within seven days. Public disclosure and release timing will be coordinated after the report is understood and a fix is available.
